name: ExPipedrive weekly coverage quick-wins
description: Every Monday, raise coverage on up to two high-ROI modules via meaningful tests.

prompts.text:
Scheduled coverage pass for blksheep80/ex_pipedrive.

Follow .cursor/skills/improve-test-coverage/SKILL.md:

1. mix coveralls.json
2. elixir .cursor/skills/improve-test-coverage/scripts/coverage_progress.exs
3. elixir .cursor/skills/improve-test-coverage/scripts/find_quick_wins.exs
4. Pick at most TWO modules not covered in prior runs (check automation memory).
5. For each module, inspect uncovered lines and write behavior-focused tests using FakePipedriveServer fixtures.
6. Verify: mix test (touched files), mix format --check-formatted, mix credo --strict.

If coverage rises and tests pass, open a DRAFT PR titled "chore: coverage quick-wins (<modules>)" with a summary of modules and new coverage %.
If nothing worth doing this week, post no PR and record in memory which modules were skipped.

Create a bead for the work: bd create "Coverage quick-wins: <modules>" --type task --priority 3

Do not write trivial line-coverage tests. Do not touch unrelated modules.
